source_parameter_notes: The published phosphorus subsurface values are recorded in Appendix 1. InVEST 3.20.0 models nitrogen subsurface transport only; the native profile therefore supplies only the supported nitrogen settings.
The appendix does not specify flow-direction algorithm or SDR l_max; those settings remain the explicit values in the retained baseline profile.
The stream threshold is 1000 contributing pixels. At the regional 30 m grid this corresponds to 90 ha, before flow-routing fractional contributions. It must not be treated as 1000 hectares.
Runoff normalization is retained from the selected baseline. Any future climate comparison must use an explicit common normalization decision on the actual masked study domain.

regional_application.baseline: Actual retained Annual NLCD 2025 land-cover edition
regional_application.domain: Changes and forest-area quotas use the exact retained reporting mask for the 116 South Carolina reporting HUCs. Native hydrology retains the full 217-HUC contributing domain plus the configured upstream buffer.
regional_application.interpretation: Regional application of published transition and area rules. The paper used a 2016 baseline; retained current regional sources determine the new source extent and eligible counts.
regional_application.spatial_allocation: Use the existing scenario preparation operation with explicit retained suitability/eligibility selections. Store actual requested and converted cell counts and tie/allocation rules with each resulting scenario.
regional_application.management_mask: grid.files.reporting_mask, the same pixel-centre selection used by native reporting

climate.historical_source_in_study: Average annual precipitation for 1981–2010; the publisher abstract gives this period without attributing the historical source to WorldClim.

native_ndr_normalization.formula: RPI_i = P_i / mean(P over valid cells in the native masked runoff proxy)
native_ndr_normalization.uniform_scaling_result: For an unchanged validity mask and auto-computed average, a uniform positive multiplier cancels from numerator and denominator.
native_ndr_normalization.fixed_average_source: Use the mean of the retained native baseline masked_runoff_proxy raster for an explicitly selected common-reference comparison.

climate.sdr: The paper lists six sediment output models with precipitation marked n/a. Separate rainfall-erosivity inputs control SDR; annual precipitation is not its erosivity input.
